scenes.scene_title: Grand Master Bedroom Suite 180-Degree Panoramic Reveal
scenes.prompt: Mind-blowing 16:9 wide-angle interior camera sweep of the ultimate luxury master bedroom suite (03_bedroom_inside_villa.jpg). Smooth 180-degree panoramic tracking shot starting from the king-sized bed with crisp white 1000-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens, panning across rich warm teak wood paneling, plush bedroom lounge chairs, and opening out to the sunlit balcony terrace window (10_villa_balcony_terrace.jpg). Sheer white silk curtains fluttering softly in gentle ocean breeze, hidden warm LED headboard accents glowing. 100% photorealistic 8K architecture photography, zero text, hyper-attractive visual.

scenes.scene_title: Ultimate Luxury Spa Bathroom Full View Showcase
scenes.prompt: Sensational 16:9 full wide-angle showcase of the en-suite luxury spa bathroom (04_bathroom_inside_room.jpg). Ultra-smooth camera tracking shot moving past the double sink marble vanity with polished chrome fixtures, revealing the freestanding oval soaking bathtub with delicate steam wisps rising, and seamless glass rainfall shower. Golden morning sunlight beams cutting through large privacy glass window reflecting off Italian Carrara white marble. Photorealistic 8K architecture photography, zero text, mind-blowing luxury visual.

scenes.transition: Vertical rocket camera acceleration initiating high-altitude satellite map zoom

scenes.scene_title: Photorealistic 3D Satellite Map View Orbital Hyper-Zoom Out Finale
scenes.prompt: Mind-blowing 100% photorealistic Google Earth Studio 3D satellite map hyper-zoom out effect: Starting directly from above the luxury spa bathroom (04_bathroom_inside_room.jpg), camera explodes upward through the glass roof, shooting vertically past the 3D villa estate rooftop into a 100m aerial drone view (08_villa_drone_view.jpg), and continuously accelerating up into a 5,000m high-altitude top-down satellite map perspective. Revealing the entire tropical island coastline, turquoise coral ocean reefs, and realistic atmospheric clouds. Hyper-realistic orbital camera motion finale, zero text, 16:9, ultimate video conclusion.
